changeSet.author: dulichso
changeSet.sql: UPDATE homestay_profile SET suitability = guest_policy WHERE (suitability IS NULL OR TRIM(suitability) = '') AND guest_policy IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(guest_policy) <> ''

changeSet.author: dulichso
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO place_contact (place_id, channel, value, is_public, sort_order) SELECT p.id, 'GOOGLE_MAPS', LEFT(TRIM(p.google_map_link), 500), 1, 30 FROM place p WHERE p.google_map_link IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.google_map_link) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_contact c WHERE c.place_id = p.id AND c.channel = 'GOOGLE_MAPS')

changeSet.author: dulichso
dulichso
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE place ADD CONSTRAINT chk_place_google_rating CHECK (google_rating IS NULL OR (google_rating >= 0 AND google_rating <= 5))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE place DROP CHECK chk_place_google_rating

changeSet.author: dulichso
changeSet.sql: UPDATE place SET attributes = JSON_REMOVE(attributes, '$.excelArea', '$.excelImageStatus') WHERE JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(attributes, 'one', '$.excelArea', '$.excelImageStatus')
